# Scholarship ruleset -- algorithms.md 4.2, Literature Review 2.3.
# a(1) high GPA, a(2) financial need, a(3) community service,
# a(4) disciplinary flag, a(5) research project.
r1: IF a(1)=1 THEN y=1
r2: IF a(1)=1 & a(4)=1 THEN y=0
r3: IF a(1)=1 & a(4)=1 & a(5)=1 THEN y=1
r4: IF a(2)=1 & a(3)=1 THEN y=1
r5: IF a(2)=1 & a(3)=1 & a(4)=1 THEN y=0
